content:
One of the most popular Mac AI transcription apps is about to receive a major update, with a redesigned transcription editor and significantly improved performance. Here's what's new.

MacWhisper 14 officially launched

If you haven't heard of MacWhisper, it's an excellent app developed by prolific indie developer Jordi Bruin.

It uses local AI models, including OpenAI's Whisper and Nvidia's high-speed Parakeet, allowing users to quickly and easily transcribe audio, video, meetings, and system sounds on their Mac.

I use it myself every day to handle the pre- and post-production parts of my podcast workflow, and it comes highly recommended.

Since MacWhisper launched in 2023, Bruin has been expanding features, streamlining the user experience, and delivering impressive performance improvements along the way.

MacWhisper 14 continues this direction, with a brand-new editor, faster execution, and numerous tweaks under the hood.

Here's what Bruin had to share about this update:

According to Bruin, based on early user feedback, MacWhisper 14.1 has already been released, fixing and optimizing several issues with the new editor. Version 14.1 also adds Gladia as a cloud transcription provider, allowing users to use their own Gladia API key for transcription.

MacWhisper 14 also includes:

A revamped AI services screen with a clearer, more usable interface. AI models from major providers have been updated. Smoother experience when playing multiple transcripts simultaneously. Various improvements to the transcription window, including smoother Cmd+A behavior and real-time editing interaction. Deepgram improvements, adding EU/US region selection, profanity control options, and expanded language support for Nova 3. Cloud transcription uploads no longer require loading the entire file into memory. Fixed issues with menu bar positioning, audio/video drag-and-drop sync, idle CPU usage, and edge cases in meeting recording

MacWhisper Pro users can upgrade to version 14 for free. Bruin is currently offering a 14% discount for users upgrading to Pro.
